items.summary: Run fp32 element-read linear-texture probe on gfx1100 (Linux) and gfx1201 (Windows): build+run projects/TIGRE/probe/tex_filter_probe.cpp, record verdict (REJECTED/LINEAR/POINT) in probe/README.md table. Baseline gfx90a=REJECTED. Lets us scope the TIGRE PR texture claim and PORTING_GUIDE arch-scope precisely.

When moat-port syncs CERN/TIGRE#809 (multi-GPU TV halo exchange overlap), the fork's cuda_to_hip.h needs four new mappings the PR's commits use in GD_TV.cu, GD_AwTV.cu and tv_proximal.cu: cudaEventCreateWithFlags, cudaEventDisableTiming, cudaStreamWaitEvent and cudaMemcpyPeerAsync (to their hip* names). Since commit f7ef26a, cudaDeviceCanAccessPeer, cudaDeviceEnablePeerAccess and cudaErrorPeerAccessAlreadyEnabled appear only in gpuUtils.cu's CUDA-only branch and need no mapping. The MI355X/gfx942 validation of #809 added the mappings only in never-pushed scratch branches, so without them the HIP build of the synced fork fails to compile. Nothing to do until #809 merges upstream and a sync round starts.

decided.note: Nothing to do until CERN/TIGRE#809 merges and a sync round starts.

summary_history.summary: When moat-port syncs CERN/TIGRE#809 (multi-GPU TV halo exchange overlap), the fork's cuda_to_hip.h needs seven new mappings the PR's commits use: cudaEventCreateWithFlags, cudaEventDisableTiming, cudaStreamWaitEvent, cudaDeviceCanAccessPeer, cudaDeviceEnablePeerAccess, cudaErrorPeerAccessAlreadyEnabled, cudaMemcpyPeerAsync (to their hip* names). The MI355X/gfx942 validation of #809 added them only in never-pushed scratch branches, so without them the HIP build of the synced fork fails to compile. Nothing to do until #809 merges upstream and a sync round starts.
summary_history.reason: #809 commit 5 (f7ef26a) moved the peer-access setup in gpuUtils.cu into the CUDA-only #else branch, so three of the seven mappings are no longer compiled on HIP.

items.summary: At the next moat-port sync with CERN/TIGRE master: Common/CUDA/tigre_release_on_error.hpp (added upstream in #854) includes <cuda_runtime_api.h> directly, which does not exist in the HIP build, so the synced fork fails to compile until that include goes through cuda_to_hip.h like the other CUDA sources. Found by the #856 prototype on master cac83e7, fixed there only in a never-pushed scratch tree.
